definitions.gloss: group home; small-scale residential care facility
definitions.explanation: A small residential facility where a few people with dementia, disabilities, or other care needs live together with support from staff. Distinct from a large nursing home in scale and atmosphere.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧グループホーム⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{暮|く}らしている→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧。
examples.english: My mother lives in a group home.

examples.japanese: ⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{認知症|にんちしょう}→認知症：04419_ninchishou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧グループホーム⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: A group home for dementia patients has opened in our neighborhood.

examples.japanese: グループホーム⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{少人数|しょうにんずう}→少人数：12465_shouninzuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{家庭的|かていてき}→家庭的：16047_kateiteki⟧な⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}できる→生活する：01839_seikatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: In a group home, residents live in a small-group, family-like atmosphere.

notes:
From English "group home." In Japan the term most often refers to facilities under the ⟦{介護|かいご}→介護：04805_kaigo⟧⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧ system for people with dementia (⟦{認知症|にんちしょう}→認知症：04419_ninchishou⟧{対応型|たいおうがた}⟦{共同|きょうどう}{生活|せいかつ}→共同生活：24978_kyoudouseikatsu⟧⟦{介護|かいご}→介護：04805_kaigo⟧), though it is also used for facilities serving people with intellectual or developmental disabilities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- グループホーム⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to move into a group home
- ⟦{認知症|にんちしょう}→認知症：04419_ninchishou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧グループホーム: dementia group home
- グループホーム⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{職員|しょくいん}→職員：20206_shokuin⟧: group-home staff

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{老人|ろうじん}ホーム→老人ホーム：28075_roujinhoomu⟧: nursing home — larger-scale, more institutional
- ⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧{養護|ようご}⟦{老人|ろうじん}ホーム→老人ホーム：28075_roujinhoomu⟧ ({特養|とくよう}): special nursing home — public, for people needing heavy care
- デイサービス: day service — daytime-only care, residents go home at night
